summary: Iteration 19 backend tests for real NWS weather alerts + admin-managed alert locations. 16/16 tests pass. Verified GET/POST /api/weather/alert-locations (auth, validation, drop-bad-rows, 12-cap, state/country upper-casing, label trim to 80, persistence). Verified GET /api/weather/alerts auto-seeds from active brand on first call, returns required schema fields with severity in {high,moderate,low}, doesn't crash for Denver point, _brand_swap removes 'Tennant' literals while Pfizer is active. Regression: /api/branding/manual still saves promo_video_ids (used activate=false + TEST_ company so active Pfizer brand untouched) and /api/admin/servers still returns totals. Admin alert-locations were cleared at module teardown so next iteration re-seeds from Pfizer facilities.

minor.issue: Seeding relies on geocoding-api.open-meteo.com (no API key) which could be flaky in CI — fallback only triggers if no facilities at all. Currently working but a network dip would slow first-call by 6s per facility.
Validates body shape but silently drops malformed rows — clients get no per-row error feedback. Spec allows either 400 or drop, so acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 8739 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; should be split into routers (weather, branding, admin, etc.).
_fetch_live_nws_alerts swallows ALL exceptions per location with `continue` — silent failures hide NWS outages from logs. Add structured logging.

WeatherAlertLocationIn pydantic model is declared but never used in set_weather_alert_locations — endpoint accepts raw Dict[str,Any]. Either use the model (FastAPI auto-validates lat/lng types and returns 422 cleanly) or remove the unused class.
POST /api/weather/alert-locations returns 200 even when zero valid rows came out of a non-empty list (e.g. all dicts bad) — caller has no signal that nothing was saved.
Hard-coded Tennant default seed in _seed_alert_locations_from_brand makes brand_swap responsible for hiding it on Pfizer; safer to derive defaults from active brand only.
No rate-limiting / debounce on /api/weather/alerts which fires NWS calls per user per 60s poll — at scale this will hammer api.weather.gov.
seed_data_creation: Created throw-away brand 'TEST PromoCo Iter19' via /api/branding/manual with activate=false (no impact on active Pfizer brand). Admin's weather_alert_locations is cleared on module teardown so next /alerts call re-seeds from active brand as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file is reusable at /app/backend/tests/test_iter19_weather.py. Active brand should still be Pfizer (we didn't activate the TEST brand). Admin's monitored locations is empty (cleared in teardown); first /api/weather/alerts call will re-seed from Pfizer facilities via open-meteo geocode. NWS API may be quiet so live=true assertion is gated; do not strengthen that assertion. WeatherAlertLocationIn pydantic model is defined but unused — POST uses raw Dict; if main agent wires the model in, the bad-body test now expects 400 but FastAPI would return 422 — adjust accordingly.
rca of the issue: n/a — no failing functionality. One residual TEST brand 'TEST PromoCo Iter19' exists in db.company_brand (is_active=False); harmless but main agent may delete it if cleanliness matters.
